capabilities: Preview each match with checkboxes before applying
Refine instructions across a kept history
Run vault-wide replacements with snapshots and restore
Screen generated patterns for unsafe backtracking
disambiguation: Not a general vault-hygiene or bulk-text-transformation suite; it only turns a plain-language instruction into a reviewed regex replacement.
extras: Documentation is hosted externally (Getting started, Features and usage, Troubleshooting). With a Claude endpoint, note text samples and earlier instructions are sent to Anthropic, and the fixed temperature 0 is not sent, so identical input may not produce identical rules. Interface is bilingual (English/German). The README notes ksawl/obsidian-alchemist shares the alchemy imagery but is a general vault-hygiene toolkit with a different job.
problem: Writing correct regular expressions for search-and-replace is hard and error-prone, and unreviewed replacements can silently change the wrong text.

relations.evidence: With the LLM Endpoint Manager plugin and a Claude entry in it, Transmute can use Claude
Transmute can use Claude instead of a local model

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible LLM server (e.g. LM Studio or Ollama)

summary: Natural-language search-and-replace tool where a local LLM writes the regex and you review each match before applying.
